prompt:
Create a commercial funding partner media kit page. The page should help a funding partner present themselves professionally to referral partners, local businesses, podcast hosts, event organizers, and networking groups.
Visual style: clean professional media kit with editorial layout, profile hero, credibility cards, downloadable asset sections, and polished finance branding.
Strong hook: “A Funding Partner Your Network Can Actually Trust.”
Hero message: “Use this media kit to introduce the funding partner, explain services, share referral language, and make collaboration easy.”
CTA: “Download Media Kit”
Sections needed:
- Profile hero
- Bio section
- Funding specialties
- Who they help
- Referral partner language
- Approved headshot/logo placeholders
- Social links
- Downloadable assets
- Contact CTA
- Final CTA
Generate static files.
